sources.preview_branch: aat/20261030-154651 (PR #11) — latest packaged Preview; PR #12–#14 only fix ZIP download URLs
sources.main_note: main only has deploy/ + zip — does NOT contain Preview HTML

findings.detail: index.html references 18 root-absolute assets (e.g. ['/favicon.ico', '/site.webmanifest', '/apple-icon-57x57.png']). On file:// these resolve to file:///static/... not the local folder — SPA JS never loads.

Language is stored in localStorage selectedLanguage (found=True); UI LanguageSwitcher calls i18next.changeLanguage. No dedicated /vi|/en HTML files in ZIP. Paths /en /vi on live server are SPA catch-all (same index.html).

Blog/case content queries Hygraph with locales from selectedLanguage. Offline/file:// cannot reach https://api-ap-northeast-1.hygraph.com/v2/clkqm652e1wb501ulfbxbbgss/master → EN content for dynamic sections empty/fails.
index.html preconnects fonts.googleapis.com — offline fonts missing (secondary to language bug).
FLF-preview (PR #11, branch aat/20261030-154651): 12 HTML pages; EN tree=0; all checked pages lang=vi → no language switch control exists to click on file://.

Opening file:///tmp/flf-old/site/index.html: browser requests ['file:///static/js/main.97fda272.js', 'file:///static/css/main.d5633398.css'] which do not exist. Relative fix would be ./static/... but build emits absolute /static/...

reproduction_steps: 2. Mở index.html bằng trình duyệt qua file:// (kéo thả hoặc Open File)
3. Quan sát: trang trắng / "You need to enable JavaScript" hoặc không render — vì /static/js/*.js 404 trên file://
4. Mở DevTools → Network: các request /static/... và fonts.googleapis.com fail
5. Không thể bấm chuyển VI↔EN vì LanguageSwitcher nằm trong bundle JS không tải được
6. (Đối chứng online) https://www.flf.vn — LanguageSwitcher đổi localStorage selectedLanguage + gọi Hygraph locales; URL vẫn /about không thành /en/about
7. Preview FLF-preview/option-b/index.html mở file:// được menu nhưng KHÔNG có nút VI/EN — thiếu HTML EN dựng sẵn
